title: The price is too high
body: I was really looking forward for this app, I’m subscriber of 3-2-1 Thursday, read the book and planing to preorder the workbook but the price for this app is too high…If buyout price is 69.99 than ok but annually? ☹️That seems bit too much. I understand that having an app that you need to maintain could be pricey but 20-30$ annually could be more fair in my humble opinion.
author: MajkyA
